parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=10: val_bpb 0.970103, improving my best 0.978650. Increasing capacity from 8 to 10 pays off even with the increased training time. Next: testing MATRIX_LR 0.025 (lowering it from 0.025 to match my previous stable setup) to see if the deeper model requires more stability.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 10 to test capacity limits, while ensuring MATRIX_LR is at a stable 0.025.
